sources.author: legendsciber
patch_list: Every car reports as unlocked, so the whole garage is available right away no matter how the car would normally be earned.

Every ad-gated reward works without watching an ad and without a network connection: continuing after a crash, free car unlocks, free upgrades, the end-of-race multiplier, bonus rubies and daily quest rerolls are granted instantly.
Rubies are pinned to 999,999,999 whenever they are earned, spent, purchased or loaded from a save, so the balance can never run out and every car stays affordable.
VIP status and the active subscription are always reported, so VIP cars and every VIP-gated feature stay available without Google Play billing.
